title: Genesys VTT
description: Genesys VTT 0.0.167 QA: adds the complete Realms of Terrinoth Talent Catalog metadata to the Talent Library. The catalog is built from the official Realms of Terrinoth Table 2-4 plus mandatory errata additions and contains 112 setting-valid Talents across Tier 1-5, including both Terrinoth-original and Genesys Core talents used by the setting. Genesys Talents Expanded v5.0 is used as the working cross-reference index while official Terrinoth sources remain authoritative. Full copyrighted rules text is not bundled; catalog entries include structured metadata, prerequisites/exclusions where encoded, and existing Rule Elements for implemented talents such as Parry, Second Wind, and Finesse. Preserves the 0.0.166 Talent Library, 0.0.165 Character Creation Data Foundation, Actions, Rule Engine, combat, encounter, and narrative dice work.
